acceptance: Only the exact receipt-bound successor identity of a quarantined blocked predecessor can pass linked-worktree startup validation.
Foreign, malformed, stale, digest-mismatched, issue-mismatched, authority-missing, branch-mismatched, base-mismatched, or unrelated concurrent requests remain rejected.
The #708 predecessor remains unchanged and its quarantine route remains visible and auditable.
The exact #708 current-main successor can be created through the normal ai-start command after this correction; an unrelated task still fails.
Lifecycle documentation and generated capability projections describe the narrow bootstrap boundary.
guidelines: Make the receipt-bound exception exact and fail closed.
Preserve quarantined predecessor evidence without mutating it.
Provide executable positive and negative startup regressions.

intent.problem: #708 has a valid quarantined successor receipt, but ai-start treats the quarantined predecessor as an ordinary active Work Item and rejects that exact successor, creating a self-bootstrap deadlock.
constraints: Use the explicit user bootstrap authority only for #737 initial evidence creation.
Do not make a general concurrent-start allowance or modify #708 evidence.
Return immediately to the normal Work Item, preflight, finish, archive, PR, merge, and closure lifecycle.
